subject.title: fix(auto-reply): older completed replies stall or vanish when a follow-up message starts a long turn

question: Should an older completed reply be released after 20 seconds when a newer same-target turn is still active but has not visibly replied?
rationale: The implementation is a deliberate message-ordering policy change rather than a mechanical correction with a uniquely determined outcome.

options.title: Adopt bounded settlement
options.body: Accept the 20-second fallback so a completed older reply is no longer withheld for an indefinitely silent newer turn.

options.title: Retain strict newer-turn fencing
options.body: Keep the current behavior that an active newer turn may continue withholding older deliveries until it ends or visibly wins.

options.title: Define a narrower contract first
options.body: Specify channel- or payload-specific ordering behavior before selecting an implementation.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded settlement
recommendation.body: Accept the 20-second fallback so a completed older reply is no longer withheld for an indefinitely silent newer turn.
